name: Poké Ball
effect: +0 — Standard capture device.

name: Great Ball
effect: +2 — Reliable general-purpose upgrade.

name: Ultra Ball
effect: +4 — High-grade general-purpose Ball.

name: Heal Ball
effect: +0 — On a successful capture, the Pokémon is restored to full HP.

name: Net Ball
effect: +4 — Bonus applies against Water- or Bug-type Pokémon.

name: Dive Ball
effect: +4 — Bonus applies to Pokémon encountered underwater.

name: Dusk Ball
effect: +4 — Bonus applies at night or in caves.

name: Fast Ball
effect: +4 — Bonus applies against a Pokémon with Speed 16 or higher.

name: Heavy Ball
effect: +2 / +4 — +2 against Large targets; +4 against Huge targets.

name: Lure Ball
effect: +4 — Bonus applies to Pokémon encountered while fishing.

name: Moon Ball
effect: +4 — Bonus applies if the species evolves using a Moon Stone.

name: Repeat Ball
effect: +4 — Bonus applies if the trainer has previously caught that species.

name: Dream Ball
effect: +4 — Bonus applies against a Sleeping Pokémon.

name: Nest Ball
effect: +4 / +2 — +4 against Level 1–4 targets; +2 against Level 5–8 targets.

name: Quick Ball
effect: +5 — Bonus applies only during Round 1.

name: Timer Ball
effect: scaling — +1 after every two completed rounds, maximum +5.

name: Level Ball
effect: scaling — +2 if active Pokémon is higher level; +4 at twice the level; +6 at four times the level.

name: Master Ball
effect: automatic — Automatically succeeds on a legal capture.

name: Choice Band
effect: Physical damaging moves deal +3 final damage. After the holder uses a move, it is locked into that move until it leaves battle.

name: Choice Specs
effect: Special damaging moves deal +3 final damage. After the holder uses a move, it is locked into that move until it leaves battle.

name: Choice Scarf
effect: Gain +3 to opening Initiative and Speed checks/saves. After the holder uses a move, it is locked into that move until it leaves battle.

name: Life Orb
effect: After the holder deals damaging move damage, add +3 final damage, then lose one-tenth maximum HP (minimum 1).

name: Expert Belt
effect: When the holder deals super-effective damage, add +3 final damage.

name: Leftovers
effect: At the end of the holder’s turn, restore one-sixteenth maximum HP (minimum 1).

name: Black Sludge
effect: Poison-type holder restores one-sixteenth maximum HP at end of turn; any other holder loses that amount.

name: Shell Bell
effect: After dealing damage, restore one-eighth of the final damage dealt (minimum 1).

name: Big Root
effect: Increase HP restored by draining moves by 50%, rounded down.

name: Focus Sash
effect: If at full HP and an attack would reduce the holder to 0 HP, survive at 1 HP instead.

name: Focus Band
effect: When the holder would be reduced to 0 HP, roll 1d10; on 1 it survives at 1 HP.

name: Assault Vest
effect: Sp. Defense +2, maximum 20. The holder cannot use Status moves.

name: Eviolite
effect: If the holder can still evolve, Defense +1 and Sp. Defense +1, maximum 20.

name: Rocky Helmet
effect: When struck by a contact move, the attacker takes one-eighth of its maximum HP as typeless damage (minimum 1).

name: Weakness Policy
effect: After taking super-effective damage, Attack +2 stages and Sp. Attack +2 stages.

name: Absorb Bulb
effect: When struck by a Water-type damaging move, Sp. Attack +1 stage.

name: Cell Battery
effect: When struck by an Electric-type damaging move, Attack +1 stage.

name: Snowball
effect: When struck by an Ice-type damaging move, Attack +1 stage.

name: Luminous Moss
effect: When struck by a Water-type damaging move, Sp. Defense +1 stage.

name: Air Balloon
effect: The holder is immune to Ground-type attacks until it takes damaging move damage; then the Balloon bursts.

name: Quick Claw
effect: After opening Initiative is rolled, roll 1d10; on 1–2 add +10 to that Initiative for the encounter.

name: Quick Powder
effect: An untransformed Ditto gains +4 to opening Initiative and Speed rolls.

name: Metal Powder
effect: An untransformed Ditto gains Defense +2, maximum 20.

name: Light Ball
effect: Pikachu gains +2 to physical and special attack rolls and damage.

name: Thick Club
effect: Cubone or Marowak gains +2 to physical attack rolls and physical damage.

name: Lucky Punch
effect: Chansey’s physical attacks score critical hits on natural 19–20.

name: Scope Lens
effect: Holder’s damaging attacks score critical hits on natural 19–20. Critical-range effects do not stack.

name: Razor Claw
effect: Holder’s damaging attacks score critical hits on natural 19–20. Critical-range effects do not stack.

name: Flame Orb
effect: At the end of the holder’s first turn in an encounter, it becomes Burned for 1d4 rounds.

name: Toxic Orb
effect: At the end of the holder’s first turn in an encounter, it becomes Poisoned for 1d4 rounds.

name: White Herb
effect: When one or more stats are below their starting stage, reset all negative stat stages to 0. Positive stages remain.

name: Power Herb
effect: When the holder uses a move that requires a charging turn, skip that charge and resolve the move immediately.
